journey.title: Re-entry: add a capability to a configured install
journey.purpose: An operator returns to a configured install, adds one scenario, and re-applies — without re-answering decisions they already made.

steps.intent: Arrive at the resumed step rather than the first step.
Navigate back and add one more capability.
Consent to the additional host requirement the new capability introduced.
Re-apply and see that unchanged items report as already satisfied.

claims.statement: Re-entry lands at the resumed step, not at the beginning of the flow.
No decision made in the first pass has to be made again.
Re-applying reports unchanged items as already satisfied rather than repeating work.
